weapons.name: On the Fall of an Aeon

passive.name: Moth to Flames
passive.text: When the wearer attacks, increases their ATK by **8/10/12/14/16%** in this battle. This effect can stack up to **4** time(s). After the wearer breaks an enemy's Weakness, increases DMG dealt by **12/15/18/21/24%**, lasting for **2** turn(s).

passive.name: Run!
passive.text: Increases the wearer's ATK by **10/12.5/15/17.5/20%**, and increases their DMG to enemies afflicted with Burn or Bleed by **16/20/24/28/32%**. This also applies to DoT.

passive.name: Spare No Effort
passive.text: Increases DMG dealt by the wearer by **20/25/30/35/40%**. The wearer also deals an extra **20/25/30/35/40%** of DMG to enemies whose current HP percentage is equal to or higher than the wearer's current HP percentage.

substatLine: SPD (breakpoint) > CRIT RATE = CRIT DMG > ATK%

entries.name: Hehe! Don't Get Burned!
entries.text: Deals Fire DMG equal to **100%** of Hook's ATK to one designated enemy.

entries.name: Hey! Remember Hook?
entries.text:
Deals Fire DMG equal to **240%** of Hook's ATK to one designated enemy. In addition, there is a **100%** base chance to inflict Burn for **2** turn(s).
When afflicted with Burn, enemies will take Fire DoT equal to **65%** of Hook's ATK at the beginning of each turn.

entries.name: Hey! Remember Hook?
entries.text:
Deals Fire DMG equal to **280%** of Hook's ATK to one designated enemy, with a **100%** base chance to Burn them for **2** turn(s). Additionally, deals Fire DMG equal to **80%** of Hook's ATK to enemies adjacent to it.
When afflicted with Burn, enemies will take Fire DoT equal to **65%** of Hook's ATK at the beginning of each turn.

entries.name: Boom! Here Comes the Fire!
entries.text:
Deals Fire DMG equal to **400%** of Hook's ATK to one designated enemy.
After using Ultimate, the next Skill to be used is Enhanced, which deals DMG to one designated enemy and enemies adjacent to it.

entries.name: Ha! Oil to the Flames!
entries.text: When attacking a target afflicted with Burn, deals Fire Additional DMG equal to **100%** of Hook's ATK and regenerates **5** extra Energy.

entries.name: Ack! Look at This Mess!
entries.text:
Immediately attacks the enemy. Upon entering battle, Hook deals Fire DMG equal to **50%** of her ATK to a random enemy. In addition, there is a **100%** base chance to inflict Burn on every enemy for **3** turn(s).
When afflicted with Burn, enemies will take Fire DoT equal to **50%** of Hook's ATK at the beginning of each turn.

entries.name: Innocence
entries.text: Hook restores HP equal to **5%** of her Max HP whenever her Talent is triggered.

entries.name: Naivete
entries.text: Increases the chance to resist Crowd Control debuffs by **35%**.

entries.name: Playing With Fire
entries.text: After using her Ultimate, Hook has her action advanced by **20%** and additionally regenerates **5** Energy.

entries.name: Early to Bed, Early to Rise
Happy Tummy, Happy Body
entries.text: Extends the duration of Burn caused by Skill by 1 turn(s).

entries.name: Don't Be Picky, Nothing's Icky
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: It's Okay to Not Know
entries.text: When Talent is triggered, there is a 100% base chance to Burn enemies adjacent to the designated enemy target, equivalent to that of Skill.

entries.name: Let the Moles' Deeds Be Known
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Always Ready to Punch and Kick
entries.text: Hook deals 20% more DMG to enemies afflicted with Burn.
